title: Tulip
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='petal' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0245e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='petalLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9eb5'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5c85'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='leaf' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7be07b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2fa82f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stem' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ec85e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2e9e2e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='48' width='8' height='40' rx='4' fill='url(#stem)'/>

  <!-- left leaf -->
  <path d='M50 78 C36 74 24 62 22 50 C34 54 46 64 50 72 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>
  <!-- right leaf -->
  <path d='M50 82 C64 78 76 66 78 54 C66 58 54 68 50 76 Z' fill='url(#leaf)'/>

  <!-- tulip cup: left petal -->
  <path d='M30 48 C28 30 34 20 42 18 C44 30 44 40 42 50 Z' fill='url(#petalLight)'/>
  <!-- right petal -->
  <path d='M70 48 C72 30 66 20 58 18 C56 30 56 40 58 50 Z' fill='url(#petalLight)'/>
  <!-- center petal -->
  <path d='M38 50 C38 28 44 16 50 14 C56 16 62 28 62 50 Z' fill='url(#petal)'/>
  <!-- base of cup -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='16' ry='6' fill='#e0245e'/>

  <!-- petal highlight -->
  <path d='M46 22 C47 30 47 40 46 46' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
